summary: EGPS runs the FULL ~200-predicate regression corpus every cycle (~minutes of go-test under fleet load). Meta's predictive test selection (engineering.fb.com 2018, arXiv:1810.05286) catches 99.9% of regressions running ~1/3 of tests. Our deterministic equivalent needs no ML: select regression predicates whose packages intersect the cycle's changed packages (internal/changedpkgs is the existing SSOT) plus always-on red-team + this-cycle scopes; run the FULL corpus at batch boundaries and on any selected-red so selection can never hide a regression class. Double win: fewer predicate-seconds under load directly reduces the class-B env-flake surface (batches 17-20: ~20% of FAILs) AND cuts per-cycle token/wall cost.
